findings.violation: Input type should be "url" to properly validate website URLs.

findings.evidence: `<input id="member-input" name="membership_number" type="text" inputmode="numeric" placeholder="Must be 8 digits" required="">`
findings.violation: Label requires "8 digits" but there is no pattern validation to enforce this constraint.
Field uses type="text" with inputmode="numeric" which is inconsistent; numeric inputs should use type="number".

findings.evidence: `<input id="postal-input" name="postal_code" type="text" autocomplete="postal-code" required="" size="3">`
findings.fix: Remove the `size="3"` attribute or increase it to at least 10
findings.violation: The size="3" attribute makes the field too narrow for most postal codes (US ZIP codes are 5+ digits, Canadian codes are 7 characters).
The select element is missing a name attribute, so its value will not be submitted with the form.
